card.name: Or after "when prescribing" in opioid warnings
card.fires_on: The word "or" (or a comma) right after "prescribing" in the opioid abuse-risk warning "Consider these risks when prescribing or dispensing [drug]". It also fires on the comma in "Take care when prescribing, preparing, and administering".

modes.label: Prescribing or dispensing
modes.description: The word "or" linking prescribing and dispensing in the opioid diversion and abuse risk sentence.
modes.example: Consider these risks when prescribing<< or>> dispensing Meperidine Hydrochloride

modes.label: Prescribing, preparing, administering
modes.description: A comma after "prescribing" in a list of handling steps in an acetaminophen warning.
modes.example: Take care when prescribing<<,>> preparing, and administering Acetaminoph

card.writes: It suppresses "assign" words, so the next word is less likely to be a form of assign, which fits a verb like dispensing.
card.plain: It marks the spot after "prescribing" where the text adds a second action such as dispensing.
